decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling.
Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall be built using materials to match those used in the construction of the extension hereby approved.
description: Erection of part single storey rear extension and two storey side extension and erection of a detached building in rear garden for use as a gymnasium
